script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: “Saul sent home” describes Saul being sent to Tarsus from Caesarea, not an event shown happening in Tarsus.
“Paul names his hometown” takes place in Jerusalem, not Tarsus.
“Born in Tarsus” describes Paul speaking to a crowd in Jerusalem, not an event happening in Tarsus.
Terms such as “Grecian Jews,” “citizen,” and “zealous” may need simpler wording or brief explanations for a fifth-grade reading level.
